newsitem.title: USA: US tax bill may lower cap gains rate again in 2001.
newsitem.headline: US tax bill may lower cap gains rate again in 2001.

text.p: The tax cut bill being negotiated by congressional Republicans and the White House was expected to include a measure to lower the top capital gains tax rate a second time starting in 2001, congressional aides said Monday.
The tax legislation was expected to cut the maximum capital gains tax rate to 20 percent from 28 percent.

A new proposal that was not part of the original Senate or House bills would lower the top capital gains tax rate again to 18 percent starting in 2001 for investments held more than five years, congressional aides said.
